expected_row: Locally finite p-groups in Golod groups and an AT section — Alec Kriebel; v1.0.0. Preprint and Zenodo publication date: 2026-10-24. Affirmative answer to Kourovka 21.131 for every prime: a countable infinite locally finite original-definition AT p-group is a quotient of a subgroup of a classical homogeneous, residually finite Golod p-group. General theorem also embeds every countably infinite locally finite p-group in a canonical Golod group in the exact 9.76 sense. Target is infinitely generated; no resolution of 13.55 is claimed. Seven-page AI-assisted preprint; two fresh sequential full-package AI adversarial reviews found no substantive defect or required correction. No independent human peer review or formal verification. Bounded originality audit; original 1986 source inspected through primary indexed text, with PDF-custody limitation disclosed. Includes LaTeX, exact verifiers and review/priority records.
